units.source_text: 到了岁暮，即使不是此种荒僻之处，天色也异乎寻常。

en.t: By the end of the year, even in places less remote and desolate than this, the sky had taken on an unusual look.

units.source_text: 宇治山中自不必说，没有一天晴明，风狂雨横，积雪不消。

en.t: In the mountains of Uji, of course, not a single day was clear; wild winds drove the rain sideways, and the piled snow did not melt.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言晨夕怅惘沉思，心地浑如梦境。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, brooded in sorrow morning and evening, his heart as if lost in a dream.

units.source_text: 大女公子断七之日，大做功德，非常体面。

en.t: On the Elder Princess's forty-ninth day memorial, elaborate rites of merit were performed with great dignity.

units.source_text: 匂亲王也致送隆重吊仪，又斋僧布施。

en.t: Prince Niou also sent solemn offerings of condolence, and held a meal for monks with generous alms.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言终不能久居此间而愁叹直到新年。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, could not in the end remain there long, and passed the time in grief until the New Year.

units.source_text: 各处亲朋，也都怪他闭居山中，久无音信。

en.t: His relatives and friends everywhere wondered at his shutting himself away in the mountains and sending no word for so long.

units.source_text: 如今已过断七，自然非返京不可，但悲痛之情难于言喻。

en.t: Now that the forty-ninth day had passed, he naturally had no choice but to return to the capital, though his grief was beyond words.

units.source_text: 他住在这里期间，出入人数众多。

en.t: While he had been staying there, many people had been coming and going.

units.source_text: 今后离去，此间势必冷清，因此众侍女不胜悲伤。

en.t: Once he left, the place was sure to grow lonely, and so the ladies-in-waiting were overcome with sorrow.

units.source_text: 她们回忆目睹大女公子逝世而惊呼痛哭之时，觉得现在虽然安静，反比那时更加痛苦。

en.t: They remembered the time when they had seen the Elder Princess die and had cried out in anguish; now, though all was quiet, it felt even more painful than then.

units.source_text: 她们都说：“从前每逢兴会，常蒙他惠然来访。

en.t: They all said, "In the past, whenever there was some pleasant occasion, he would often kindly come to visit us.

units.source_text: 此番久居山庄，朝夕得仰尊颜，似觉比前更加温柔多情。

en.t: This time, while he stayed so long at the mountain villa, we could see his honored face morning and evening, and he seemed even gentler and more tender than before.

units.source_text: 无论闲情细事，或生计大事，都蒙他悉心照料。

en.t: Whether it was some small matter of leisure or an important concern of daily life, he took thoughtful care of everything for us.

units.source_text: 自今以后不能再见他了！”

en.t: From now on, we will no longer be able to see him!"
